Sten mk2
Creator: Lotnik
Original publication: https://opengameart.org/content/sten-mk2
Original publication date: 16 May 2016
License: Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported (CC BY 3.0)
License deed: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/
License legal code: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/legalcode

Changes: This project converted the original FBX into a glTF/GLB model,
rescaled it for the first-person view, split the side magazine into an
independently movable mesh, and repacked the original Unity metalness RGB,
smoothness alpha and occlusion map into glTF occlusion/roughness/metallic
channels. The original albedo and normal images are embedded in the GLB.
The source FBX and texture files remain unchanged under source/original/;
the downloaded archive remains under source/. The split and material pipeline
are recorded in docs/WEAPON_CHARACTER_ASSETS.md. Lotnik does not endorse this
project.
